scope: Architecture, contract, gap analysis, and release boundary only. No implementation is authorized by this addendum.

requirements.requirement: One generic remote ingress envelope with a strict schema, expiry, nonce, channel/operator/device identity, bounded text, attachment references, and canonical correlation ids; adapters normalize into it and never execute.
requirements.evidence: docs/architecture/REMOTE-INGRESS-CONTRACT.md; base has no remote contract/route/service (audit: all remote* paths absent on 8b2a300); existing precedent node/src/services/telegram.mjs:147-150 and node/src/services/execution-authority.mjs:200-206
requirements.acceptance_condition: Envelope schema validated strictly; expired/unknown-channel/duplicate requests refused or reconciled; no envelope path reaches an executor without Authority.

requirements.requirement: No second authority: every interface enters the same canonical preparation/decision/execution path; remote channels are adapters over private composition-root ports, never HTTP emitters of authority.
requirements.evidence: tests/arch/execution-authority.test.ts; tests/arch/capability-authority.test.ts:313-369; control object explicitly private (node/src/services/execution-authority.mjs:13-14)
requirements.acceptance_condition: No remote interface can mint actors, widen scopes, or execute without an exact authority operation; proven by escalation-attempt tests.

requirements.requirement: Authentication and authorization are separate: channel allowlisting and adapter binding never imply permission; consequential classes require step-up (device-attested or local confirmation).
requirements.evidence: Telegram adapter requires an approved authority.grant before any actor exists and is scoped to ['desktop.action']; desktop approval long-poll exists for local step-up
requirements.acceptance_condition: Compromise of a channel account cannot perform CLASS A actions without device attestation or local confirmation; denial is auditable.

requirements.requirement: Capability-scoped operator permission model with autonomy modes (DENY / ASK_EVERY_TIME / ALLOW_LOCALLY / ALLOW_REMOTELY / ALLOW_WITH_BOUNDS / OWNER_PREAUTHORIZED) consulted before preparation; policy narrows or pre-approves within Authority and never mints permission.
requirements.evidence: Base has risk classes only (common/security/operation-policy.mjs:4-21) plus global desktop grants (runtime store; contract common/contracts/desktop.ts:3-20) and BYOK consent; no capability permission matrix
requirements.acceptance_condition: Per-capability policy decisions are recorded with policy version; a policy can never bypass Authority, audit, or verification.

requirements.requirement: Broad permission is not Authority bypass: even OWNER_PREAUTHORIZED operations produce request identity, Authority decision, attempt identity, execution record, verification, and receipt.
requirements.current_state: PARTIAL (invariant true today; no preauthorized mode exists)
requirements.evidence: execution-authority contract tests under tests/arch/execution-authority.test.ts:140-156 (fail-closed receipts); audit rows carry identities/digests only
requirements.acceptance_condition: A preauthorized operation still yields a durable decision row and a verification/receipt chain identical in shape to a manual approval.

requirements.requirement: One capability taxonomy (Capability Fabric: AVAILABLE/INSTALLED/ENABLED/PERMISSION_GRANTED/HEALTHY/AUTHORIZED_FOR_OPERATION) with typed capability descriptors; no parallel capability states.
requirements.evidence: C3-12 (MISSING — V1.1; 'Do not create parallel states before the Fabric decision'); artifacts/integration-certification/CAPABILITY-FABRIC-DISPOSITION.md:7
requirements.acceptance_condition: A versioned capability manifest parses fail-closed; states are exactly the Fabric taxonomy; plugin trust and Authority remain the enforcement substrate.

requirements.requirement: Deterministic capability router selects an executor by the fidelity/safety hierarchy (native capability > typed connector > MCP > CLI/terminal > browser > Desktop Control GUI) and records a routing decision with candidates, filters, and basis.
requirements.evidence: Base has no executor hierarchy; agent tools are a hardcoded 9-tool registry (node/src/services/agent-tools.mjs:297-492); model-router capabilities field is always empty (node/src/services/model-router.ts:88,107)
requirements.acceptance_condition: Same inputs yield the same routing decision; eligibility filters (state, policy, device, trust, health, qualification, Local-Only) are enforced; no silent downgrade.

requirements.requirement: Desktop Control is a router-selected fallback, never a default: GUI automation is chosen only when no qualified higher-tier capability exists and policy permits GUI fallback; no interface talks to the Desktop Control adapter directly.
requirements.current_state: PARTIAL (desktop service bounded and verified; router missing; GUI fallback rule undefined)
requirements.evidence: C4-16 (desktop permission boundary IMPLEMENTED + VERIFIED); C4-20/RELS-03 separate lane for the broad GUI mission
requirements.acceptance_condition: REMOTE-011 passes: Desktop Control is invoked only through the canonical router and Authority, with a routing receipt proving the choice.

requirements.requirement: Device identity and a device agent contract: stable device_id, operator-approved enrollment, OS-protected keys, capability manifest per device, truthful state reporting, revoked credentials dead after restart; the agent is executor/state-provider only.
requirements.evidence: No device id/registry/fleet exists on base; health component remote_bridge is always UNKNOWN (node/src/services/health-supervisor.ts:133-139)
requirements.acceptance_condition: A device can enroll only through an approved operation with a valid one-time code; revoked devices cannot reconnect; state reports preserve null/UNKNOWN.

requirements.requirement: Device enrollment, key rotation, suspend, and revoke are operator-governed operations with auditable receipts; device sharing requires explicit re-enrollment.
requirements.evidence: Base authority revokes actors, not devices (node/src/services/execution-authority.mjs:156-163); no device credential model exists
requirements.acceptance_condition: Rotation preserves execution continuity while old keys fail; revocation is provable after restart.

requirements.requirement: Devices are typed (OWNER / BOUNDED / INGRESS / DEVELOPMENT) with per-class policy defaults; an INGRESS device cannot execute capabilities and a BOUNDED device cannot execute OWNER-class operations even with approval.
requirements.evidence: No multi-device representation exists in code; model capability tiers are unrelated hardware tiers
requirements.acceptance_condition: Per-class refusal tests pass for cross-class escalation attempts.

requirements.requirement: Canonical mission entity with durable identity, state machine, obligations, and transition journal; mission_id is the addressable target for remote status, cancellation, and notifications.
requirements.evidence: C2-11 (MISSING — V1.1): agent sessions are an in-memory Map (node/src/services/agent-loop.mjs:250); trajectory written only at terminal state (:613-621)
requirements.acceptance_condition: A mission survives restart with state/obligations intact; status is answerable without any live chat or WS connection.

requirements.requirement: Mission cancellation is a canonical control operation: stop new dispatch, cancel interruptible attempts, settle atomic work, capture state, preserve completed work, mark obligations, end CANCELLED/PARTIAL/FAILED with a receipt. Never a model 'stop' prompt.
requirements.evidence: C5-15 (MISSING — V1 REQUIRED); agent routes expose no cancel (node/src/routes/agent.ts:94-253); tasks have a real cancel (node/src/services/task-service.mjs:1016-1038)
requirements.acceptance_condition: REMOTE-010 passes: cancellation produces truthful terminal state, keeps completed artifacts, and writes an authority-gated receipt.

requirements.requirement: Async missions are independent of chat connections: accept request, disconnect client, mission continues, reconnect and query canonical state.
requirements.evidence: Agent loop runs detached from HTTP (node/src/services/agent-loop.mjs:829-831) but state is in-memory; tasks/training/downloads continue without a client
requirements.acceptance_condition: REMOTE-009 passes across an ingress channel disconnect/reconnect cycle.

requirements.requirement: Remote status answers are projections over canonical state with an as_of timestamp and explicit unknowns; Resident never infers activity from chat history.
requirements.evidence: C3-11 PARTIAL (model-facing mission awareness is one stage/revision line); C1-13 PARTIAL (runs lack model id/hash); C1-02 route reachability gaps
requirements.acceptance_condition: REMOTE-001 passes: status query returns canonical state with explicit unknown fields and no fabricated activity.

requirements.requirement: Canonical outbound notification events for mission/device/runtime/security lifecycle; channel adapters deliver; delivery failure never changes mission truth; duplicate delivery is idempotent per event_id.
requirements.evidence: HOOK_EVENTS only task.started/completed/failed/diagnostics.new; no mission.* events exist
requirements.acceptance_condition: REMOTE-015 passes: verified completion emits one canonical event; channel delivery failure is observable and truth-neutral.

requirements.requirement: Email is modeled as distinct capabilities (search/read/draft/send/delete) with graded policy; consequential send/delete require per-operation decision unless explicitly preauthorized with bounds; no single binary email permission.
requirements.current_state: MISSING (no email connector; Outlook COM draft op is the only mail surface and never sends)
requirements.evidence: No IMAP/SMTP/Gmail/Graph/calendar code on base; C4-05/C4-06 egress classification/journal coverage gaps
requirements.acceptance_condition: A send capability cannot be invoked under a read-only policy; denied sends produce zero egress and an auditable refusal.

requirements.requirement: Telegram adapter boundary (future implementation): operator association, envelope normalization, attachment references, canonical submission, notification delivery, stale-request expiry, durable replay defense, rate limits, sanitized logs; no authority/mission/desktop/model logic stored in the adapter.
requirements.current_state: PARTIAL (transport + authority adapter IMPLEMENTED + VERIFIED; adapter scope desktop.action only; dedupe in-memory; transport battery stale)
requirements.evidence: tests/arch/execution-authority.test.ts:183-241; tests/arch/capability-authority.test.ts:313-369; C5-09 (dedupe does not survive restart); C4-06 (Telegram egress not journaled)
requirements.acceptance_condition: REMOTE-005/006 pass for the Telegram path; a restart does not re-execute a previously handled update.

requirements.requirement: Connection model: device-initiated outbound channels only; no non-loopback listener for V1.1; no cloud relay as canonical truth; relay must be self-hostable and disabled under Local-Only if ever added.
requirements.evidence: All listeners are loopback (node/src/server.ts:99,373; scripts/facade.mjs:133,300; daemon/server.mjs:45,679); no TLS anywhere; Telegram long-poll is the only off-machine channel
requirements.acceptance_condition: No product bind accepts non-loopback connections; channel functionality is proven through outbound paths only.

requirements.requirement: Local-Only ON disables remote ingress and remote egress, reports the state truthfully, and settles pending work without silent execution. Ownership stays with the P0 lane; remote lane supplies the requirement and consumes the signal.
requirements.current_state: PARTIAL (agent/BYOK/continuation gates exist; adapter traffic not uniformly gated or journaled)
requirements.evidence: tests/arch/connections-routes.test.ts:129-148; tests/arch/byok-routes.test.ts:220-229; C4-06 (Telegram egress unjournaled)
requirements.acceptance_condition: REMOTE-012 passes: with Local-Only ON, remote adapters report unavailable and no remote-controlled execution occurs.

requirements.requirement: Workspace Trust is separate from operator/channel identity: remote authorization never elevates an untrusted workspace; remote status exposes trust state and a local approval path.
requirements.current_state: MISSING (no Workspace Trust system to integrate with)
requirements.evidence: No workspace trust entity on base; workspace identity is a server-owned path (node/src/server.ts:68)
requirements.acceptance_condition: REMOTE-013 passes: a remote task against an untrusted workspace returns BLOCKED without execution.

requirements.requirement: High-consequence policy classes: CLASS A privileged control (strong auth + per-operation decision, never preauthorized-only), CLASS B irreversible external (per-operation decision unless bounded preauthorization), CLASS C bounded write, CLASS D read/observe. Authority remains the canonical owner.
requirements.evidence: Base has risk classes but no capability classes or autonomy modes; desktop grants are one global set
requirements.acceptance_condition: REMOTE-004 passes for a CLASS A and a CLASS B action from a remote channel.

requirements.requirement: Idempotency/replay: channel-unique request_id with durable dedupe ledger, nonce + monotonic ids + expiry, reconciliation-before-retry; duplicates never double-execute missions, emails, commits, or deletions.
requirements.current_state: PARTIAL (authority single-use operations verified; ingress dedupe absent; Telegram dedupe in-memory)
requirements.evidence: C5-08 (IMPLEMENTED + VERIFIED); C5-09 (Telegram lastUpdate in-memory); tests/arch/execution-authority.test.ts:57-63,111-128
requirements.acceptance_condition: REMOTE-005 and REMOTE-006 pass, including across a process restart.

requirements.requirement: Offline/reconnect semantics: local truth persists; missions continue without clients; restart reconciles in-flight attempts; pending approvals expire and are re-proposed, never silently executed; duplicate delivery is deduped.
requirements.current_state: PARTIAL (workflow/handoff/continuation durable; live agent state not durable)
requirements.evidence: C2-11, C7-16, C7-30; tests/arch/workflow-service.test.ts:342-344; tests/arch/worker-handoff-live.test.ts:279-305
requirements.acceptance_condition: REMOTE-008/009 pass across offline, restart, and reconnect cycles.

requirements.requirement: Audit/receipt chain reconstructs operator → channel → request → Authority decision → routing decision → device → mission → attempt → capability → side effect → verification → notification; secret content never logged.
requirements.current_state: PARTIAL (authority/provenance/workflow chains exist; routing, device, attempt, model identity, notification dimensions missing or partial)
requirements.evidence: C1-13/C1-14/C5-23 gaps; audit rows carry identities/digests only; egress journal partial (C4-06)
requirements.acceptance_condition: REMOTE-016 passes: one query reconstructs the full chain for a remote-originated operation.

requirements.requirement: Multi-model workflow synchronization per ADD-001: mission DAG, transition ownership, immutable candidate identity, stale-review invalidation, bounded repair, worker reassignment, per-transition Authority and Admission, human approval boundary, completion ownership.
requirements.evidence: ADD-001 (MATERIAL GAP — PARTIAL, P1, V1-required, release blocking for the multi-model workflow); ADD-001 closure evidence list
requirements.acceptance_condition: ADD-001 closure evidence list is satisfied: typed DAG/transition contract; identities and policy receipts; deterministic tests for each transition, stale review, bounded repair, reassignment, denial, admission, approval, false completion.

requirements.requirement: Resource Admission is a gate on every remote-triggered start (model/training/agent/worker); REFUSE/QUEUE settle as truthful states, never partial execution.
requirements.current_state: PARTIAL (decision service verified; not a gate; route facade-unmapped)
requirements.evidence: C5-19; C1-08; tests/arch/resource-admission.test.ts:23-97; tests/arch/readiness.test.ts:46-60
requirements.acceptance_condition: A remote start under resource pressure returns QUEUED/REFUSED with zero dispatch; admission ref is recorded in the attempt.

requirements.requirement: Any future remote route is fully enrolled (descriptor or central policy), facade-mapped, and contract-regenerated before shipping; migration waivers are not acceptable for remote ingress.
requirements.evidence: tests/arch/route-authority-coverage.test.ts mechanics; common/facade-route-map.json; tests/arch/openapi-drift.test.ts
requirements.acceptance_condition: Coverage accounting shows 0 CONFLICTING / 0 UNCLASSIFIED with the new route; facade probe returns the typed backend response, not legacy 404.

requirements.requirement: Extension boundaries for future editions: capability packs, workflow packs, skill packs, policy profiles, tool adapters, device adapters. No edition forks Authority, Resident, orchestrator, or project truth; no core hardcoding of edition behavior.
requirements.current_state: PARTIAL (plugin trust/sandbox + workbench bundles exist as substrate; no pack taxonomy beyond Fabric design)
requirements.evidence: plugins/test-manager.mjs:19-37 (network deny-by-default); tests/arch/workbench-manager.test.ts:45-89
requirements.acceptance_condition: A new capability/workflow pack can be installed, trusted, and routed without modifying Authority, Resident, orchestrator, or capability taxonomy.

requirements.requirement: V1 claim guard: V1 does not claim remote operation, remote ingress, device agents, or mobile support; remote is V1.1+; V1 obligations (mission cancellation semantics, long-horizon remote clauses, workflow synchronization, frozen contracts) are visible and owned.
requirements.current_state: MISSING (no remote claim exists to guard yet; guard required at V1.1 planning)
requirements.evidence: C4-19 claim-guard discipline; base has no remote surfaces
requirements.acceptance_condition: Release wording and claim manifests contain no remote capability claim; V1.1 items are labeled as such.

proof_requirements.condition: Authenticated status query returns canonical mission/device state with as_of and explicit unknowns
Unauthenticated/unknown-channel request denied before preparation with a sanitized receipt
Authorized read-only remote mission runs end-to-end through Authority and returns verified results
Consequential action requires the correct policy class; denial typed and auditable
Duplicate request executes once; the duplicate returns recorded state
Stale/expired/replayed request denied with no side effect and an evidence row
Wrong-device substitution denied; target device identity bound in envelope and operation
Device offline yields truthful BLOCKED state; no substitution, no false success
Mission continues after the remote client disconnects; status recoverable on reconnect
Remote cancellation produces canonical CANCELLED/PARTIAL state with preserved completed work
Desktop Control invoked only through the canonical router and Authority; no direct adapter path
Local-Only ON blocks prohibited ingress/egress and reports the state truthfully
Untrusted workspace does not gain trust from a remote request
Worker crash mid-attempt detected; attempt failed; reassignment/continuation bounded and recorded
Verified completion emits a canonical notification; delivery failure does not change truth
Receipt chain reconstructs operator → channel → request → mission → attempt → capability → device → verification

anti_claims: V1 does not ship or claim remote operation
No non-loopback bind without TLS, device identity, replay defense, and rate limits
No chat account implies workstation control
No free-text-to-command path without proposal and Authority
No second permission engine, taxonomy, mission identity, or audit chain
No remote adapter scope wider than policy
No remote promotion of workspace trust
No cloud relay as canonical truth

threat_controls.control: channel allowlist is configuration not authority; operator-approved scoped adapter binding; step-up required for consequential classes
device attestation unavailable for a foreign device; CLASS A requires local confirmation or device proof
nonce + monotonic native ids + expiry + durable dedupe ledger + Authority single-use
request_id dedupe returns recorded state; no re-execution
device identity bound in envelope and operation; mismatch denied before preparation
truthful BLOCKED/INTERRUPTED states; no substitution; reconnect reconciliation
attempt failure is a state; bounded continuation/reassignment; no silent model substitution
mission truth is durable and independent of Resident process memory

threat_controls.threat: stale capability manifest or Authority decision
threat_controls.control: qualification scope enforced for consequential classes; operations expire and digest-bind args
typed refusal; no plaintext fallback; no partial execution
BLOCKED state; trust cannot be promoted remotely
remote adapters unavailable; truthful reporting; pending work settles
ingested content is DATA; invocation requires Authority; harness injection doctrine applies
digest mismatch denial; scopes exclude permission/revoke classes
single mission transition owner; conflict is a rejection, not last-writer-wins
cooperative cancel; non-interruptible action settles; final CANCELLED/PARTIAL receipt
